settings.ui-language.description: Editor interface language is persisted immediately and independently of the display draft; cancelling the draft keeps this preference.

native.settings.ui-language.description: Native interface language is persisted immediately; the host retains the display draft and selection.

fields.global.statusline_language.label.description: Main and subagent output language belongs to the display draft and changes persistent output only on display Save; Cancel preserves the saved setting.

ui.hints.save_and_continue.description: Native editor footer. Save the display draft and keep the editor open.

ui.hints.save_and_exit.description: Editor footer. Save the display draft and close the editor after a successful save.

ui.hints.clear_filters_short.description: Compact component list footer. Clear both the search query and the selected category.

shortcuts.action.event-refresh.description: Terminal keyboard shortcut action. Switch the refresh interval to the event-only mode in the current display draft.

ui.refresh.auto.description: External editor status. The current view re-reads already available data. This label describes the view only, including when a source or a package job is shown.

ui.refresh.cancel_requested.description: A package review in the external editor has received a cancellation request. The worker has yet to confirm that it stopped.

ui.refresh.checking_timeout.description: An external source job passed its deadline. The view keeps checking for a final result from the same job.

ui.refresh.read_now.description: External editor shortcut for an immediate read of published status. Provider and package execution have separate actions.

ui.refresh.read_only.description: Task report in the external editor. The view displays previously published evidence.
